issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify calculateTotalPrice(Meal) should return a double (to provide double precision for financial calculations), but the solution implements calculateTotalPrice as returning an int. This mismatch in return type can confuse students about the expected API and precision and may cause compilation or grading issues if tests expect a double.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the calculateTotalPrice method's return type consistent with the problem statement by changing its signature to return double in the implementation (and template if applicable) and ensure its calculation uses double precision. Alternatively, update the problem statement and UML to specify an int return type if integer prices are intended. Ensure all references (UML, description, template, and solution) use the same return type.
